# 17 — the generated API client was gitignored, making half of contract.sh vacuous

Status: resolved 2026-08-17 in commit 1c761ee
Severity: high
Source: task 2.11

## Problem

`.gitignore` carried:

    # Generated API client — regenerated by contract.sh, never hand-edited
    android/core-api/generated/

`contract.sh` detects drift with `git diff --exit-code -- "$SPEC" android/core-api`.
A diff against an ignored directory always succeeds. So the moment the client
was generated, the gate would have reported OK whether the client matched the
contract or not — including after a breaking contract change.

The comment beside the rule is what makes it dangerous: it reads as a
justification ("regenerated by contract.sh"), so a reviewer would nod at it.

## Why this keeps happening

Fourth instance of the same shape. The lockfile that pinned nothing (07), the
audit that skipped transitives, the scripts that could not execute (a01eb17),
and now this. Every one failed toward *passing*. None has ever failed toward a
false alarm.

The common cause: each gate was written and then never observed failing. A gate
whose failure has never been seen is a claim, not a check.

## Resolution

Rule removed, generated sources committed, and the reasoning written where the
rule used to be. Verified by mutating `artifacts/openapi.json` and watching
`contract.sh` report FAILED, then reverting and watching it report OK.

## Follow-up worth doing

Every remaining gate deserves the same treatment: inject a fault, watch it fail,
then revert. Cheap, and it is the only thing that distinguishes a gate from a
comment.
